tool_limitations.limitation: The lifecycle anchor only covers activation (OnLaunched/OnActivated/OnFileActivated); it returned nothing about the Suspending/Resuming events, so it did not directly resolve the actual error.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Extend the lifecycle anchor to cover Application.Suspending/Resuming/EnteredBackground removal and the Window.Closed replacement.

failed_apis.why_tried: Carried over verbatim from the UWP SuspensionManager template to save session state on suspend.
failed_apis.root_cause: The WinUI 3 Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application class has no Suspending (or Resuming/EnteredBackground/LeavingBackground) event; desktop apps are not suspended by the OS the way UWP apps are.
failed_apis.fix: Remove the Suspending subscription and OnSuspending handler; save state from Window.Closed (e.g. window.Closed += async (s,a) => await SuspensionManager.SaveAsync();). Drop the now-unused Windows.ApplicationModel using and SuspendingEventArgs/deferral code.

special_apis.api: SuspensionManager / NavigationHelper Common template (UWP SDK samples & VS templates)
special_apis.special_handling: The Common\SuspensionManager.cs pattern builds under WinUI 3, but its App-level wiring depends on the removed Suspending event. The manager is reusable; only the lifecycle hook must be re-routed to Window.Closed.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'App' does not contain a definition for 'Suspending'
errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP Application.Suspending event does not exist on the WinUI 3 Application base class.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove this.Suspending += OnSuspending; save state on Window.Closed instead; delete the OnSuspending/SuspendingEventArgs deferral handler.

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler WMC9999 'Object reference not set' during MarkupCompilePass2
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascade of the same failing build (XAML precompile ran against a project that failed C# compile); it disappeared once the CS1061 was fixed.
errors_encountered.fix: Fix the underlying C# compile error; the XAML internal error was not independent.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Migration skill documents activation events but not the removal of the Suspending/Resuming lifecycle events, which are ubiquitous in UWP SuspensionManager templates.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent removed the Suspending hook and moved SaveAsync to window.Closed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Adding a Suspending/Resuming removal + Window.Closed replacement subsection to the lifecycle anchor and flagging the API in unsupported-api-inventory.json so the bootstrap injects an inline TODO.
